channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Journalist Don Lemon pleads not guilty in Minnesota ICE protest case
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS >> Former CNN anchor Don Lemon pleaded not guilty today in a criminal case stemming from his coverage of a protest at a Minnesota church against President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown.

item.title: Election security director Kurt Olsen linked to Fulton County probe
item.description: One of the more extraordinary aspects of President Donald Trump’s second term is this: Some of the most far-out election conspiracists who helped him spread lies about the 2020 election and then tried to overturn it are now inside the government, using the power of the state to keep Trump’s denialism alive.

item.title: South Carolina measles cases hit 950 in worst outbreak in 30 years
item.description: SPARTANBURG, South Carolina >> About a dozen times each day, medical staff at Parkside Pediatrics in Spartanburg, South Carolina, head to the clinic’s parking lot, reaching inside cars and minivans to check children and their parents for fever, rash and other signs of measles.

item.title: Hawaii attorney general says subpoenas issued in criminal public corruption case
item.description: The Hawaii Department of the Attorney General has issued “multiple subpoenas and completed several interviews” as part of its ongoing public corruption investigation, which arose from the federal bribery case that sent two former state lawmakers to prison.

item.title: ICE agents suspended after their story of immigrant shooting falls apart
item.description: Two federal agents have been suspended, and criminal charges against a man one of them shot have been dropped, after a prosecutor in Minnesota revealed that the story those agents told about the shooting was not true.

item.title: Tips flood in, prompted by video of suspect in Guthrie kidnapping
item.description: It was an affecting plea from a face familiar to millions of American households: “We are at an hour of desperation, and we need your help.”

item.title: Trump: Iran regime change may be ‘best thing’ as 2nd carrier heads to Middle East
item.description: WASHINGTON / FORT BRAGG, N.C. >> President Donald Trump today embraced potential regime change in Iran and declared that “tremendous power” will soon be in the Middle East, as the Pentagon sent a second aircraft carrier to the region.

item.title: Rep. Daniel Holt leaves state House for Hawaii DLNR job
item.description: State Rep. Daniel Holt resigned from the state House today following his appointment to serve as an executive assistant to Hawaii Department of Land & Natural Resources Chair Dawn Chang.

item.title: No. 3 Hawaii smashes No. 18 Stanford in 77 minutes
item.description: No. 3 Hawaii needed 77 minutes to sweep No. 18 Stanford 25-16, 25-15, 25-17 today at Maples Pavilion in Stanford, Calif.

item.title: Hawaii’s 1st travel-related dengue case of 2026 reported on Maui
item.description: The Hawaii Department of Health has confirmed the first travel-related dengue virus case in the state this year.
